properties.description: BUILT 2026-10-25 under dec:find-tools-also-finds-relations-and-points-to-what-joins-x-to-y (Anthony's options a and b). find_tools scores every edge type of the design's schema against the query, beside the tools and apart from them: its name split at the underscores, its hint and any field's word for it, its property names, and the node types it may join where one is named. Words match by spelling family (capabilities/capability, operated/operates, never uses/causes), each weighted by how rare it is across tools and relations together. Up to three come back under `relations`, each marked as a relation and not a tool, with the types it joins, what it means, and the call that draws it: its typed tool where one exists (constrains, governed_by ...), and create_edge with that edge_type always. A relation is shown only at a third or more of the best one's score. Every reply also carries `what_joins`: "what may join an X to a Y?" is describe_schema with from and to. No tool is added (200 served), the tools' ranking is untouched, and only find_tools' own description changed. Code: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/find_relations.rs, called from find_tools in crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/query.rs. Relation corpus: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/fixtures/find_tools_relation_corpus.json (24 queries pass, Alex's four among them; 5 known misses, each a vocabulary gap with its reason).
properties.name: find_tools finds the schema's relations beside the tools, and points to describe_schema for what joins an X to a Y
